intent: Deliver shared taxonomy/accounts, durable provider metrics/history, and database Pulse plus offline report for isolated tested-and-ready review. No production release.

findings.suggested_fix: Keep author_id from link.account.author_id and assert the native X ID remains in the existing response shape.
findings.title: Person response labels UUID as X author ID
findings.why_it_matters: Existing person intelligence consumers receive a UUID instead of the native X identifier after the FK migration.
findings.validation_reason: Native author_id assertion reproduced UUID in PostgreSQL test on 7bc690e9.

findings.suggested_fix: Resolve Account.x by author_id and pass its account object to BrandAccount.get_or_create; assert seed creates edges without warnings.
findings.title: Seed account links still receive native IDs
findings.why_it_matters: Account.pk is now UUID; normal seed loading catches the UUID conversion error and omits brand/account roles.
findings.validation_reason: Seeded BrandAccount missing reproduced in PostgreSQL test on 7bc690e9.

evidence: U8 requires both offline diagnostic report and Pulse endpoint to use the shared computation; render_benchmark_report command is absent.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the planned read-only render_benchmark_report command and a presentation adapter from build_comparison into the existing report shape; retain exact raw values, scope and complete comparison evidence without recomputing values.
findings.title: Offline report is not connected to the shared database series
findings.why_it_matters: The planned database-backed offline report cannot be produced, and its original calculation can diverge from the Pulse response.
findings.validation_reason: U8/R7 requires a shared database offline consumer; call_command(render_benchmark_report) raises Unknown command on 7bc690e9.

findings.suggested_fix: Reject completed_day_lag < 1 when configuring OpenRouter, preserving zero for sources where it is unused; add configuration test.
findings.title: Zero completed-day lag admits an invalid OR schedule
findings.why_it_matters: The reviewed scheduler can select today for OpenRouter although its source adapter requires completed UTC days, creating a permanently failing schedule.
findings.validation_reason: OpenRouter lag zero admitted by configure_collection; rejection test fails DID NOT RAISE on 7bc690e9.
